test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

The water from the river was ________ cold for me to drink directly.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3 i.e.(too)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct word to use in this context is "too," which means to a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively.
